product_context: B2B analytics SaaS. Users build dashboards and export reports.

items.text: The export button throws a 500 error every time I select more than two months of data. I lost an hour of work.
Export is completely broken for us. Error screen, nothing downloads.
Dashboard takes about 25 seconds to load every morning. It used to be instant.
Everything is slow after the last update, charts time out constantly.
I cannot find where to change my billing email. Spent ten minutes clicking around settings.
Love the new reporting view, genuinely saves me time every week.
Any chance of a Salesforce integration? We are copying records across by hand.
App crashed twice today while uploading a CSV and the data never arrived.
Pricing jumped at renewal with no warning and support took four days to reply.
The documentation for the webhooks API is missing the retry behaviour entirely.
